confirmed_structure_render_fixture.fixture_scope: detached render test only; no source-data mutation

map_click_regression.element_at_click: <canvas id="composite-map" aria-label="Shared-coordinate original and updated map comparison" width="1450" height="560"></canvas>

annotation_categories.scope: Supplied object-category annotations; not road-structure change labels.

object_motion_states.source_description: nuScenes GT instance_token + 2Hz annotations; motion states are threshold heuristics
object_motion_states.scope: Derived motion-state heuristics over object instances; not structural-change uncertainty.

independent_labels.scope: Candidate evidence-support labels cannot substitute for independently verified prior/current map changes.
independent_labels.source_reason: No independently verified prior/current change GT or held-out scenes supplied.

semantic_routing.scope: Semantic layer identity over all delivered candidates; not truth of the proposed change.

structural_quality.scope: Local geometric model decision over structural candidate windows, not a ground-truth uncertainty rate.

structural_write.scope: Full structural edit eligibility/execution, separate from local detection.

five_percent_claim.meaning: The 5% value is the user-requested comparison target, not a verified dataset statistic. Motion uncertainty and model candidate insufficiency have different denominators.

scope: Software and local-browser validation passes. Six structure-candidate model decisions have5/6 insufficient support; user5% final-structure target is not achieved, nor replaced by motion-state or semantic-routing rates.
